summary: Frontend-only test for SinaisTab signal lifecycle fix (prevTriggeredRef transition tracking) and RadarTab LIMPAR fbScore reset. All 7 scenarios PASSED in a single browser session.
critical_code_review_comments: SinaisTab signal transition logic (lines 156-163) correctly uses prevTriggeredRef Set to detect false->true transition. After GREEN/RED resolution, the strategy id is still added to newTriggered (line 162), so it won't re-fire on subsequent giros while triggers remain present — matches spec.
Edge case (minor): if user resolves via RED then does undo, the trigger might be tracked as met from stale prevTriggeredRef but undo path may not correctly update tracking. Not tested, low impact.
RadarTab.limpar() correctly resets setFbScore({wins:0,reds:0}), fbPatternsRef.current=[], setFbPatterns([]) — verified in code and via LIMPAR click test.
RadarTab.jsx is ~750 lines — still over 700 threshold, could be split (carried from iteration 17).
gatilho-scoreboard-total sums scores keyed by strategy id, including entries left over for deleted/inactive strategies stored in sessionStorage 'gatilho_scores' (carried from iteration 17).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 strategy via Admin UI (also verified via direct localStorage seed): {id:'test-strat-1', name:'Test', triggerNums:[5,10,15], entryNums:[2,8,20], active:true} stored in localStorage 'sinais_strategies'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bug fixes verified. Test flow: (T1) Enter 5,10,15 -> signal-active-test-strat-1 fires with '3 tentativas restantes' and entry balls 2,8,20. (T2) Enter 8 (hit) -> signal DISAPPEARS, gatilho-idle visible with GREEN:1. (T3) Enter 1 (non-trigger, triggers still in giros) -> no re-fire, still idle. (T4) Clear + 5,10,15 -> signal fires again; then 1,3,4 (3 misses) -> signal disappears with RED:1. (T5) Triggers 5,10,15 still in giros[5,10,15,1,3,4], enter 6 -> no re-fire (correct behavior per prevTriggeredRef). (T6) Clear + 5,10,15 -> signal fires again (new formation transition). (T7) Radar LIMPAR resets fb-scoreboard display to GREEN:0/RED:0 AND sessionStorage 'fb_score' to {wins:0,reds:0}. Used JS click via document.querySelectorAll+offsetParent filter to bypass hidden duplicate testids across tabs.
